thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: 3xx/5xx spike & routing skew observed for APAC egress, automated alert from routing-telemetry. Severity: P1.
ryan_oncall: seeing it on our dashboards too — APAC p99 token latency +600ms, error rate 502->5%.
mira_sre: I can reproduce via curl from eu-west -> apac gateway, getting mixed responses. some hits land fine, others 502.
sam_neteng: quick check — BGP sessions look stable. DNS responses for apac.gateway.redwood.net vary between 10.10.10.20 and 10.20.20.30, TTL low (30s).
ryan_oncall: customer reports started ~13:03 UTC, matches telemetry. Which regions are receiving the bad backend?
mira_sre: logs show backend pool apac-primary returning 502 intermittently, apac-fallback healthy but not being used consistently.
zoe_pm: customer-impact: a small set of Dedicated customers in APAC reporting request failures and timeouts; SLOs may be breached if not mitigated.
ops-bot: Runbook linked: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/routing-dns-splitbrain — recommend immediate pin to fallback if primary unhealthy.
ryan_oncall: initiating mitigation: plan A) pin traffic to apac-fallback for affected customers  b) increase DNS TTL to 300s once stable to prevent flip-flop. Need NetEng approval for pin.
sam_neteng: say the word. Before pin, need to confirm any session-affinity impacts. Quick check: session affinity is stateless for these routes. safe to pin.
mira_sre: rolling deploys? Nothing in progress. deploy-bot: No active rollout detected in apac clusters.
ryan_oncall: ok doing controlled pin now for tenant group 'dedicated-apac-critical' -> apac-fallback. Command:```sh
redwoodctl routing pin --group dedicated-apac-critical --to apac-fallback --reason "502 spike" --dry-run=false
```
sam_neteng: watching BGP and egress counters.
incident-bot: action applied by ryan_oncall at 1789502592: pin applied to apac-fallback for group dedicated-apac-critical.
mira_sre: telemetry: error-rate dropping to 1.2% within 30s. latency p95 improving.
zoe_pm: notify affected customers: drafting note for support to send to customers in the impacted tenant group.
ryan_oncall: creating post-incident task: investigate why DNS returned mixed A records from authoritative set; hypothesis: intermittent authoritative server serving stale zone due to partial push.
sam_neteng: traced DNS responses to two authoritative clusters: auth-eu and auth-apac. auth-eu still serving old A for apac.gateway due to zone update lag. replication logs show a race during last config push at 12:58 UTC.
mira_sre: that explains flip-flop: clients with EU-resolver get old IP pointing to apac-primary while others get apac-fallback. Combined with primary having resource pressure -> partial failures.
ryan_oncall: plan: 1) keep pin for 15m, 2) coordinate with infra to re-push zone to auth-eu and verify consistent answers, 3) increase resolver TTLs once consistent.
sam_neteng: I'm going to re-push zone to auth-eu now and monitor. Command run: ```sh
dns-ops push-zone --zone apac.gateway.redwood.net --target auth-eu --force
```
ops-bot: dns-ops job queued, started at 1789502755.
sam_neteng: push completed, validation: all auth servers returning identical records.
mira_sre: running synthetic checks from EU and APAC: consistent answers, no 502s in last 2 minutes.
ryan_oncall: reduce pin rollback in 5m if metrics stable.
zoe_pm: liaising with support, message to customers ready: "We've applied a temporary routing pin while we corrected a DNS replication issue; service should be stable now. We'll follow up with RCA."
incident-bot: note: escalation to network leads not required.
ryan_oncall: rolling back pin now. Command:```sh
redwoodctl routing unpin --group dedicated-apac-critical --reason "dns replication fixed" --dry-run=false
```
incident-bot: unpin applied by ryan_oncall at 1789503030.
mira_sre: metrics: error-rate back to baseline 0.2%, p99 latency normal.
sam_neteng: confirmed DNS answers stable and TTL set back to 300. replication lag noted as root cause; adding a guard to 'zone-push' to verify full propagation before marking success.
zoe_pm: customer comms sent, support triage closed.
ryan_oncall: handoff to night SRE: @mira_sre will keep an eye for 2hr. If spikes reappear, re-pin and page NetEng.
mira_sre: acknowledged — will monitor dashboards and run periodic synthetic checks.
ryan_oncall: incident closed (mitigated) at 1789503160. Postmortem assigned to sam_neteng.
incident-bot: incident P1 -> mitigated. Create postmortem ticket: RED-INC-2026-1789502468
zoe_pm: adding followups: (1) zone-push propagation guard, (2) add telemetry alert for DNS answer divergence across auth clusters, (3) tabletop for routing pin workflow.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. :white_check_mark:
